MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): status changed from blocked SDK_BUG to pass. The author found a real SDK defect: MujocoDriver declared only observation and tick while the MuJoCo bridge publishes time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms and seed (G6.READ_INVALID), and an empty reset schema published the catalogue class's undescribed fields (G8.NO_DESCRIPTION). Both are fixed in the SDK (MHS/changes/WAVE-A.md); the reviewer removed the package's reset workaround where it had one, regenerated the reference and re-ran the gate. After the registry rebuild the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above. The author's notes as written at the time of the block follow.

Last gate run (--backend fake): G1 pass, G2 pass, G3 pass, G4 pass, G5 pass, G6 fail, G7 warn, G8 fail, G9 skip (not run after a failing gate). G6 error READ_INVALID: the resource state does not match its state_schema: $.time_ms: additional property 'time_ms' is not allowed (allowed: "observation", "tick"). G7 warning UPSTREAM_BACKEND: the fake backend is a callable module factory, so the gate treats it as the upstream simulator and skips the native-surface check. G8 errors NO_DESCRIPTION: mhs__diana_med_2c63__world_reset: inputs 'options', 'scenario' and 'seed' have no description; G8 warnings NO_UNIT for the derived integer/number inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed. MINIMAL REPRO, independent of this package and using the SDK's own MuJoCo family driver base: MHS/sdk/src/mhs/driver/families.py:838-843 declares the served state of a MujocoDriver as {observation, tick}, while MHS/sdk/src/mhs/bridge/mujoco.py:257-268 makes MujocoBridge.read serve world_state() = {time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed}. A subclass of MujocoDriver with model_xml and a stand-in mujoco module (the SDK's own tests/driver/test_families.py:399 Pendulums is such a class) is served, and mhs.schema.validate(client.read('world')['state'], resource['state_schema']) returns exactly '$.time_ms: additional property time_ms is not allowed (allowed: observation, tick)': the same G6.READ_INVALID. No declaration the family contract allows can change it: the state_schema is built from MujocoDriver._state_fields (families.py:657-672), a private hook, and the family docstring says a member sets class attributes only, no methods, so overriding it would be a workaround rather than a supported configuration. SECOND FINDING, also family-level: the MCP reset tool takes the catalogue class inputs seed/scenario/options, while the MuJoCo family supplies no input descriptions (_SimDriver._RESET_INPUTS is empty, families.py:717 and 726-731), so G8.NO_DESCRIPTION cannot be cleared from the package; the Gymnasium family describes seed and options but not scenario. STATE OF THE PACKAGE, ready to finish once the two SDK contracts agree: driver.py is configuration only (MujocoDriver with model_path, a card entry symbol as native, a callable fake module); the model is read from the pinned clone (relative model_path, no copy and no symlink, the upstream file and its meshes stay authoritative); fake.py is a callable stand-in for the mujoco module (it reads timestep, joints and actuator ctrlranges from the model file, integrates a placeholder model, and offers exact snapshots through mj_stateSize/mj_getState/mj_setState); G1-G5 and the generated reference already pass, and the derived step contract is action.ctrl inside the model's -80..80 actuator ctrlrange. NOT COVERED even after a fix: the environment on top of the model (the spliced gripper and task objects, the observations, reward, goal and the 50-step episode limit); the fake's trajectories are placeholders, not MuJoCo's, as its fidelity gaps say. A FAMILY SWITCH DOES NOT HELP: the repository's environment classes expose no Gymnasium spaces (robopal/envs/base.py defines MujocoEnv without action_space/observation_space, and robopal/envs/manipulation_tasks/robot_manipulate.py only sets obs_dim, action_dim, min_action and max_action), so a GymnasiumDriver cannot derive its action and observation spaces from them without inventing a contract the upstream does not have (checked with an in-process Gymnasium-family probe: the served state matches, but the spaces would be the fake's). The MuJoCo family is the right helper for an MJCF model and is blocked by the two SDK contract defects above.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): Accepted the shared MuJoCo checkpoint v2 migration after independent codec review and this actual G1-G9 fake gate rerun. Regenerated the declared native_checkpoint field and conservative derived determinism; state API presence no longer implies seeded or exact continuation. The explicit basic fallback does not claim complete integration state. Earlier automatically inferred determinism is superseded by the current reference. Changed reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json, RESULT.json. Source pin, package model authorship and driver.lock.json are unchanged. No native runtime of this package or physical hardware was validated; isolated SDK engine tests are separate evidence.
